run_demo_layout_predictor: run the layout predictor demo on a directory of PNG images to detect document layout regions
create_layout_predictor: create a LayoutPredictor instance from a model artifact path on a specified device with configurable thread count
test_predict_layout: test the LayoutPredictor.predict method on a PIL Image to return bounding box predictions with labels and confidence scores
save_predictions_visualize: save layout prediction results as annotated images and text files with bounding boxes and labels
summarize_demo_main: summarize the main entry point that parses CLI arguments, downloads models, and runs the layout prediction demo
